title: Morphologies of the Peruvian mummies

tellings.quote: You have the J types, the S types, and the M types.

plain: Michels says the strange mummified bodies from Peru that his episode discusses come in three body types: "the J types, the S types, and the M types." He gives this himself, without naming a source. The point is that if the bodies are real and fall into distinct kinds, they would be more than a single odd find.
